comment_regular: Decoded animation/model-loader helper. Builds a BSSimpleList of file paths for an input path that may contain wildcards; merges loose-file FindFirstFile results when archive invalidation is enabled, then asks archive/file systems to append matches. Used by KF/model discovery, not a CustomAnim override registry.
